usedFor: Google Meet holds scheduled calls, and LeadConnector gets a contact through “Create Or Update Contact” after “New Upcoming Meeting”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Upcoming Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: Meetings about to start become contacts, and the action updates the record if it already exists.

watchOut: “New Upcoming Meeting” is polling and only sees events with a Google Meet link inside the set time window.
